name: preserve equality and caching behavior while changing the hash
definition: Keep the equality definition and instance-cache semantics intact so the new value-derived hash stays consistent with equality and does not destabilize existing object behavior.
failure_mode: New hash collides across unequal values or breaks the equality-consistency invariant

name: preserve the original input dataset file untouched
definition: Neither the transform nor the bookkeeping may modify the source input file.
failure_mode: editing the input updates the hash and fails the check
